suggested_fix: No fix required. The function returns early if the filter pointer is NULL, which prevents a NULL pointer dereference. Index arithmetic is bounded: even taps index up to phase*taps + taps-1 (or taps-2), and odd coefficients are read only when (2*pair+1) < taps, so each phase reads only its own 'taps' entries across NUM_PHASES/2+1 phases, matching the layout of the coefficient tables. Callers should continue to pass filter tables sized (NUM_PHASES/2+1)*taps.
